crossRefs.note: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let…
Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
Yahweh, remember David and all his affliction,
He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and…

translations.web: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
